provenance.input_hash_capture: Current retained metadata at bootstrap; historical input file hashes were not recorded.

face_mask_crop_occupancy.definition: Area of the chosen face mask inside the actual crop divided by actual crop area before resizing
face_mask_crop_occupancy.missing_policy: Unknown when no mask measurement is available; never inferred from a bounding box

source_refs.project_taxonomy: User-provided project taxonomy for manipulation and transformation families

previous_run_audit.near_duplicate_policy: Perceptual hashes retrieve candidates only. Exact hashes or high-precision pixel verification establish must-link edges. Unreadable candidate rows are excluded; author holdout boundaries retain priority.
previous_run_audit.source_format_balance: Decoded original image format, conditional on dataset, target and generator
previous_run_audit.transformation_balance: Canonical tag-presence marginals within dataset and target; empty tag lists are tracked as unknown. Multi-label shares use faces as the denominator.
